schema.name: access_channel
schema.description: The channel through which the access was made (e.g., 'Mobile', 'Web').

schema.name: account_status
schema.description: The status of the account at the time of access.

schema.name: customer_id
schema.description: Unique identifier for the customer associated with the account.

schema.name: customer_segment
schema.description: The segment the customer belongs to (e.g., 'Retail', 'HNI').

schema.name: product_type
schema.description: The type of product associated with the account.

schema.name: suspicious_access
schema.description: Flag to indicate if the access is considered suspicious.

schema.name: high_value_customer
schema.description: Flag to indicate if the customer is a high-value customer.

schema.name: geo_location
schema.description: Geographical location of the access event.

description: Enriched table containing customer access information with derived attributes.
